svg.title: Rotherhithe to Canary Wharf crossing map

g.text: Nelson Dock to the impound lock:
384 m under the river, ramps folded
in each dock, about 940 m end to end.
A 3.5 m cycle lane beside a 2.5 m footway.

svg.text: LAND WITHIN 750 M OF THE ROTHERHITHE PORTAL
